notes.title: Steam Cloud Error & Save Data Issue
notes.content:
There was an error with the cloud save for the trial version, but after investigating, we were able to resolve this issue!

The location of the save data has been moved accordingly, so if you want to continue using your previous save data, you may need to transfer the files.

If the data has been transferred without any problems, the following procedure is not necessary!

How to transfer:
1. Right-click on "Drunken Rogue and the End Vampire Demo" from the Steam menu screen and select "Manage -> Browse local files" from the menu.
2. Copy all the data in the SaveData folder.
3. Paste the data in {User folder}\AppData\LocalLow\26bstudio\DrunkenRogue\SaveData. If the SaveData folder does not exist, create a new one.

The user folder is probably C:\Users\(name) by default on Windows.

We apologize for the inconvenience, but thank you for your cooperation!

notes.title: Store page is now open!
notes.content:
Hello,
We are pleased to announce "Drunken Rogue" in the "Wakuwaku Games News" published today (May 24, 2024)! Based on the original "Drunken Rogue" (available for free), the game has many dungeons to explore, and in addition to the drunken rogue Rita, the "Vampire of the Ende" makes an appearance! Please look forward to it!
